owner_and_capability: Identity & Access (identityaccess: modules/identityaccess/compose) composes its own wiring under #4006: the signer-free session maintenance, the invitation maintenance, the guardian seed access, the account-reference check and the guardian welcome-mail order. The typed root (root-composition: api) holds the cross-owner glue. The legacy composition (legacy-composition: services) no longer imports the session token adapter.
affected_tables: No table changes: this cutover relocates composition and preserves the existing Identity & Access queries and writes.
atomic_cutover: Move the Identity-only constructors from services into modules/identityaccess/compose and the cross-owner glue into api/identity_*.go behind narrow row ports. NewFactoryWithModules takes a services.IdentityRoot instead of the token adapter and calls its Compose with the values the factory builds itself. The guardian welcome-mail order moves into Identity behind compose.PrecedingMails; the root reports Delivery's state. Remove the services -> modules/identityaccess/sessiontoken baseline entry in the same change. The factory loses ten Identity fields and seven methods; no route, query, table or user-visible behavior changes.
